about_item: 𝗛𝗜𝗚𝗛 𝗩𝗢𝗟𝗧𝗔𝗚𝗘 𝗦𝗨𝗥𝗚𝗘 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗧𝗘𝗖𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡: Built-in protection guards the appliance’s electronics from sudden line spikes up to 4 kV, reducing the risk of damage during storms or unstable supply and helping the cooktop last longer.

𝗣𝗢𝗪𝗘𝗥 𝗦𝗔𝗩𝗘𝗥 & 𝗔𝗨𝗧𝗢𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗖 𝗩𝗢𝗟𝗧𝗔𝗚𝗘 𝗥𝗘𝗚𝗨𝗟𝗔𝗧𝗢𝗥: Intelligent Power Saver Technology continuously optimizes wattage based on vessel size and the selected menu, while the AVR cushions minor voltage fluctuations—improving efficiency and durability.
𝟭𝟲𝟬𝟬 𝗪 𝗢𝗙 𝗣𝗢𝗪𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗨𝗟 𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗖𝗘: High wattage delivers rapid heat-up and faster boiling/frying so everyday meals are done sooner, with precise control for simmering and slow cooking when needed.

𝗜𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗚𝗘𝗡𝗧 𝗣𝗢𝗪𝗘𝗥 & 𝗧𝗘𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘 𝗖𝗢𝗡𝗧𝗥𝗢𝗟: Sensor-based logic automatically modulates power in real time to maintain target temperatures, preventing overcooking and saving energy.

authors_reviews.title: Worst induction and extremely poor customer service!
authors_reviews.text: This has been one of the worst purchases I’ve made. The induction broke down within just one month of use, and I had to get it repaired. Unfortunately, the problem happened again after around 10 months.What is even more frustrating is the terrible after-sales service. When I contacted customer support, they repeatedly gave me the contact number of the same person, even after I clearly explained that he was not reachable. When he does answer the call, he keeps giving excuses such as “I can’t come today” and never actually resolves the issue. It has now been more than a week, and despite repeatedly contacting customer service, no one has contacted me or provided any proper assistance.A product breaking down repeatedly is already disappointing, but the complete lack of accountability and support makes the experience even worse. I would strongly recommend avoiding this induction and this brand if you expect reliable quality and after-sales service.
authors_reviews.author: Aditya
